# Repository Agents

This repository provides a workspace-level agent for GitHub Actions and agentic workflow creation.

## agentic-workflows
- Location: `.github/agents/agentic-workflows.agent.md`
- Purpose: create or update GitHub Actions workflow files, repository automation, and agentic workflows using GitHub CLI/Actions guidance.
- Use when tasks mention: `gh aw`, GitHub Actions, workflow YAML, automation, CI/CD, or agentic workflow setup.
